children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 16, 2026) - Visible Gold Mines Inc.

is exploring more than 700 square kilometres of prospective ground in Québec, with a strategy focused on searching for gold near established discoveries. With significant land surrounding IAMGOLD's nearby gold discovery and management and directors collectively owning approximately 20% of the company, Visible Gold Mines is focused on advancing projects with the potential to deliver new discoveries in one of Canada's established gold regions.
